item.title: HCP Fall Open House (Online)
item.description:
Tuesday, August 25, 2026 at 6 PM

Location: Online via Zoom

Join us online on Tuesday, August 25, between 6-8 pm at our Fall 2026 Open House to learn about new and upcoming courses, hands-on workshops, community events, and expansed certificate programs’ offering. Have your work reviewed and receive a free personal consultation and discount on Fall classes.RSVP is required via this link.

item.description:
Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 12 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

Join us on Tuesday, September 1, 12:00-1:00 pm CST for online presentations of Patricia Voulgaris and Juan Orrantia’s striking and thought provoking work followed by an engaging conversation led by Natan Dvir, Managing Director of Education at HCP. Registration is required via this link.

item.title: HCP Photobook Club - Daniel Seth Kraus
item.description:
